title: REQ · World validation rejects dangling scene character references
summary: validateWorld reports scene characters missing from world.characters and interactions with unknown dialogue, flags, scenes or objects.
description: Context: validateWorld checks speakers, objects and events but never inspects scene.characters. Desired behavior: every scene character id must exist in world.characters, its interaction.dialogue must be a dialogue id in that scene, and its interaction events go through checkEvents. Expected result: a bad NPC definition fails validation with a descriptive message. Why: data-only NPC additions stay safe.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene character id absent from world.characters, When validateWorld runs, Then errors include 'unknown character: <id>'.
Given interaction.dialogue naming a missing node, When validateWorld runs, Then errors include 'unknown dialogue: <id>'.
Given interaction events with an unknown flag, When validateWorld runs, Then errors include 'unknown flag: <flag>'.
Given a valid NPC, When validateWorld runs, Then it adds no errors.

out_of_scope: Manifest asset ref checks (planPreload already reports unknown refs)
preserve: Existing validateWorld error strings and the bedroom content validity
